description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget named ReadingPane that displays the current chapter and its sections, including inline highlights and annotation features. It manages rendering chapter titles, sections, highlights, and user interactions such as adding, editing, and deleting annotations through bottom sheets and context menus.

classes.name: ReadingPane
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays the current chapter and its sections, along with inline highlights and annotation controls.

classes.name: _ReadingPaneState
classes.description: State class for ReadingPane, manages building the UI and handling user interactions such as adding or editing annotations.

methods.name: _openAddAnnotationSheet
methods.description: Displays a bottom sheet to add or edit annotations, including handling color selection, note input, and delete option.

methods.name: _ColorChoice
methods.description: A widget to select a highlight color when creating or editing an annotation.

methods.name: _HighlightedSectionText
methods.description: Renders section body text with inline highlights, supporting long-press gestures to select text regions for new annotations.

methods.name: _approximateWordRange
methods.description: Estimating start and end indices for text selection based on tap position, used for annotating portions of text.
